reuse.why: One selection function replaces the three copied hidden-filter queries and setZero's query, and copyPreviousMonth uses the same function through an id set.

duplication.why: The eligibility rule is written once and copyPreviousMonth's own hidden columns are removed; the income/tracking check and the 3/6/12 loops stay repeated as before.

placement.why: The selection lives in server/budget/actions.ts beside getBudgetData and the month-wide actions.

scope.why: Only the selection, its five consumers and focused tests (using storeTemplates as the editor does).

maintainability.why: A single named definition with a comment makes the rule easy to change; the per-action income check is still repeated.
